sentence: Tallies group hoodie orders by size, lets each member pick or drop a size and add a few guests, and shows progress toward the minimum needed to print.
use_when: A group is ordering hoodies or shirts and needs a count per size
There is a minimum order quantity and a deadline to hit
Members want to add friends or family as guests with their own sizes
Someone wants a quick view of who picked what size
dont_use_when: The group needs to vote on a single choice, like a design or a date
Money needs to be collected or split between people
Items have many options beyond size, such as colors or quantities per person
